name: The Donut Counter
description: Authentic mid-century American diner counter serving nostalgic buttermilk crullers, kettle-boiled glazed rings, and bottomless black drip coffee.

announcement.message: Old-fashioned buttermilk crullers & diner filter coffee: Serving our community for over 65 years.

hero.title: SERVED FRESH AT THE COUNTER SINCE 1958
hero.subtitle: Crisp golden buttermilk crullers, real kettle-cooked apple fritters, and freshly brewed diner coffee poured with a warm smile.

contactAndHours.address: 58 Main Street Historic District, Route 66, Flagstaff, AZ 86001
contactAndHours.holidayNotice: Closed on Christmas Day to let our diner crew celebrate with family.

promotions.headline: Counter Classic: Free Large Filter Coffee with Baker's Dozen
promotions.description: Enjoy an extra 13th donut and complimentary hot coffee with every counter dozen.

newsletter.headline: The Counter Chronicles Gazette
newsletter.subtext: Stories from our regulars, classic baking history, and monthly counter specials.
